subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-08-21
html:
Week 12 Pulse

Shipped since last pulse (2026-08-14): the "MCP Server Security" blog post (2026-08-17, closing the standing content.md trust/security gap open since kickoff) and the "Google Ads Reporting for Agencies" blog post (2026-08-20, re-scoped from a fresh live SE Ranking pull after the original content.md skeleton was declared exhausted, targeting the highest-volume unshipped P1 term in the whole audit). Connector matrix and comparison hub both remain fully caught up with no further items until a human unblocks catalog.ts. The headline this week is unchanged from last week: rank positions are still flat at zero after a third full week of daily checks — see below. This also closes out the original 12-week-strategy.md window (kickoff 2026-07-04); a fuller Month-3/quarter-review deep-dive (score vs. all three months' KPIs, refresh the keyword map, set the next quarter) is a separate, larger session than this weekly pulse and is still owed.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending — GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing, but this sandbox still has no outbound GA4 API access. Waiting on the scheduled data Action (12-week-strategy.md Week 8) to backfill this row.

Ranking movement

Third full week of daily position checks for the askarlo.app SE Ranking project (site_id 12704162, Google US), 2026-08-14 through 2026-08-21. Result: still 0 of 22 tracked keywords have a measurable position (all outside the top 100) on every single day checked, no exceptions, for the third consecutive week.

Checked every daily position (08-14 through 08-21, 8 consecutive days, all 22 keywords) directly via getKeywordStats — pos: 0 (unranked) on literally every keyword/day combination, no partial or flickering rankings anywhere in the window, same as the two prior pulses. Month 2 KPI #1 ("first measured position for ≥15 of 22 keywords") and KPI #2 (3 lowest-KD terms entering top-50) are both now off track for the full four-week Month 2 window — Month 2 (August) closes at the end of this week with neither KPI met. Three consecutive content-only sessions since the last pulse (08-17, 08-20, and this pulse) haven't moved rank yet, consistent with the plan's own "content alone doesn't rank a DA-0 domain without off-page signal" framing, but this is now the third consecutive zero, not a startup-lag story.

Traffic vs last week

Pending / unchanged. SE Ranking's own organic + paid index (getDomainOverviewByCountry, US) still shows zero indexed keywords for askarlo.app — consistent with 0/22 tracked positions above. Backlinks (getBacklinksSummary, domain mode): still 2 backlinks / 1 referring domain, still only from futurlabs.dev — no change since 2026-08-01, now 7 weeks flat. AI search overview (getAiSearchOverview, US): still 0 link_presence, 0 ai_opportunity_traffic, null average_position, null brand_presence — unchanged from every prior pulse.

Anything broken?

No build/pipeline regressions. Clean rm -rf .next && npm install && npm run build this session — compiled successfully, same 9 pre-existing (app)/* + /welcome prerender failures as every prior session (missing NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL, Vercel-only secret), not a regression. SEO Report Email Action: 23 of 24 runs green all-time (same single historical failure as every prior pulse — the first shakeout run on 2026-07-04); both sessions since the last pulse (2026-08-17, 2026-08-20) sent and archived cleanly, plus the biweekly Keepalive job (3/3 green).

mailchimp's catalog.ts ETA ("August 2026") is now due and still coming_soon. Re-checked src/lib/connectors/catalog.ts this session: meta_ads/linkedin_ads/meta_pages (all "May 2026") are 3+ months overdue; hubspot/mailerlite (both "July 2026") are 6+ weeks overdue; tiktok_ads and stripe ("June 2026") are 2+ months overdue; shopify ("April 2026") is the single most-overdue entry in the whole catalog at 4+ months past its own date. salesforce/pipedrive still waitlist; gohighlevel/clarity/gtm still absent entirely. Every coming_soon entry in the catalog is now past its own stated ETA — none has flipped to live since the connector matrix was completed on 2026-08-03. Open since 2026-07-20, now 10+ sessions, still needs a human product-owner call before any of these get a public marketing page.

Off-page Phase 1 (Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub) is still 0 of 6 — the single most overdue item on the whole plan, flagged since Week 4, still blocked on a human with a browser (this sandbox has no outbound HTTP). GSC submission is also still open, unchanged since kickoff (2026-07-04).

Reading the week

This is the last week of the original 12-week-strategy.md window, and the pattern that's held since week 1 hasn't broken: content production stayed disciplined (two more overdue gaps closed, not volume for its own sake — the standing trust/security page and the highest-volume unaddressed P1 term), but rank data is unmoved for a third straight week and the backlink profile hasn't grown past its original single referring domain in seven weeks. That's not a surprise given the plan's own framing (organic on a DA-0 domain is a 6-12 month ramp), but it does mean the two levers that were flagged as the actual constraints back in Week 4 — off-page link-building (0/6) and the catalog.ts connector decisions (10+ sessions open) — are now also the two things blocking Month 2's KPIs from closing this week, and neither is human-independent. Worth flagging plainly heading into the Month 3 window: without a human spending 20 minutes on directory listings or a go/no-go call on the nine stalled connectors, the next several weekly pulses are likely to read the same as this one and the last two. A fuller quarter-review session (scoring all three months' KPIs against 12-week-strategy.md, refreshing the keyword map) is still owed and would be the right place to decide whether to keep the current cadence or change tack.
